name: ssd-bench-structured-schema-design
notes: Structured: PostgreSQL schema design with detailed requirements. ~620 prompt tokens. Output is SQL DDL.

messages.content:
Design a PostgreSQL 16 database schema for a multi-tenant LLM inference platform. The schema must support all of the following business and technical requirements:

Tenant management:
- Each tenant has an id (UUID), name, created_at, and a tier (enum: free, pro, enterprise).
- Each tenant has a configurable rate_limit_rpm (requests per minute) and a monthly token quota (token_quota_monthly).
- Tenants can be soft-deleted (deleted_at nullable timestamp with time zone).

Model registry:
- A model is identified by its snapshot_path (unique text, e.g., mlx-community__gemma-4-e2b-it-mxfp8) and has a display_name, arch (text, e.g., Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration), weight_quant (text), and is_available (boolean, default true).
- A model has a max_ctx_tokens integer and a flag supports_vision (boolean) and supports_audio (boolean).
- Track created_at and updated_at.

Request log (high-volume append table):
- Each request has id (UUID), tenant_id (FK), model_id (FK to model), ts_utc (timestamptz, default now()), prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, kv_quant (text), temperature (numeric(4,2)), was_cached (boolean, default false), ssd_hits (integer default 0).
- This table will receive ~50,000 inserts/day. Optimize for bulk append and time-range queries. Use declarative range partitioning by month on ts_utc.
- Include a BRIN index on ts_utc and a B-tree index on (tenant_id, ts_utc).

Usage aggregates (materialized, refreshed hourly):
- A materialized view requests_hourly_by_tenant that pre-aggregates: tenant_id, hour (date_trunc('hour', ts_utc)), request_count, total_tokens, total_latency_ms, cache_hit_count.
- Include a UNIQUE index on (tenant_id, hour) to support ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE refresh strategies.

SSD cache namespace registry:
- Track which tenants use which project namespace on the SSD KV-cache tier: tenant_id, namespace (text), budget_bytes (bigint), created_at, last_used_at. Unique on (tenant_id, namespace).

Constraints and best practices:
- All foreign keys with ON DELETE RESTRICT unless noted otherwise.
- Use CHECK constraints to enforce: rate_limit_rpm > 0, token_quota_monthly >= 0, prompt_tokens >= 0, completion_tokens >= 0, latency_ms >= 0.
- Use GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY for surrogate integer PKs where UUIDs are not used.
- Add comments (COMMENT ON COLUMN) for every column in the request_log table explaining its purpose.
- Provide the complete DDL in a single SQL script with transactions (BEGIN/COMMIT), including the enum type, all tables, all indexes, the materialized view, and example index-only-scan-friendly composite indexes.

Also: propose a row-level security (RLS) policy for the request_log table so that a tenant API key JWT (tenant_id claim) can only SELECT its own rows.
